paths.title: Engineering Judgment
paths.readerQuestion: How do I make a defensible technical decision under constraint and uncertainty?
paths.outcome: Frame a bounded technical decision, compare options, identify failure modes, justify a choice, and define review triggers.

paths.title: Semantic Ontology
paths.readerQuestion: How do I create a shared model of meaning that people and software can inspect?
paths.outcome: Define a bounded domain, model concepts and relationships, test competency questions, and publish known limits.

paths.title: Systems Stewardship
paths.readerQuestion: How do I coordinate useful work and help a shared system improve responsibly?
paths.outcome: Specify work, assign accountable roles, review evidence, govern change, and evaluate system learning.
